main.title: AfterLedger: find what they left behind
main.heroTitle: Find everything they left behind. Settle it one claim at a time.
main.heroText: When someone dies without leaving a record of what they held, or of who should receive it, their family is left to find and claim it all. AfterLedger reads the family's own papers in any language, finds the accounts and policies nobody listed, and prepares each institution's claim from its current rules, with the source behind every line.
main.noAccount: No account needed. The sample families, banks and papers are fictional; the rules and their sources are real.
main.startOwn: Start a case of your own
main.foundText: A ₹436 debit every May is the premium for PMJJBY, a government life cover of ₹2,00,000. Rajesh was 52, and cover runs to 55 once enrolled, so it was live when he died.
main.familiesText: Each sample case is a complete family file, made by the same steps and checks as a new case, with prepared answers standing in for the AI models. Open one to see what AfterLedger found, the claims it prepared and the rule behind every step.
main.deleteAsk: Delete this case and its papers? This cannot be undone.
main.howText: Nine stages that overlap in practice. The family is asked to confirm things at seven points, and only about what they can know. Agents check the rules against their sources.

s1.name: Tell
s1.text: Talk or type in your own language.

s2.name: Whose rules
s2.text: Which country governs each holding and each paper.

s3.name: Read
s3.text: Every paper read twice, by different methods.

s4.name: Connect
s4.text: Names across scripts become people; payees become institutions.
s4.you: You confirm a match only without proof

s5.name: Discover
s5.text: Payments and papers point to what nobody listed.

s6.name: Research
s6.text: Each institution's rules, from official sources, checked twice.

s7.name: Plan
s7.text: One plan with owners, questions and clocks.

s8.name: Prepare
s8.text: Forms found, filled, read back and checked.
s8.you: You review and sign each pack

s9.name: Follow up
s9.text: Replies read, clocks watched, delays costed.
s9.you: You record what you sent and got back

main.howFoot: Every reply goes back into planning, and what it teaches is kept, with its source, for the next family.
main.sourcesText1: Tap Why? on any step to read the rule in its own words, from the page it came from, with the date it was last checked. A value from your papers opens on the page and line it was read from.
main.sourcesText2: Rules are researched by two agents working apart. A quote that cannot be found word for word on its page is dropped before anyone sees it.
main.exampleRule: Narmada Bank may not ask for a surety, because the claim is under the ₹15 lakh threshold.
main.exampleQuote: “No bond of surety from a third-party shall be obtained in case of claims up to the threshold limit.”
main.exampleSource: Reserve Bank of India, Commercial Banks (Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025, paragraph 289, as updated on 1 October 2026
main.challengeText: Pick a country, and a bank and a situation if you like. AfterLedger researches the rules while you watch, drops any quote it cannot find on the page, and compiles a plan with a letter in the bank's own language.
main.myQuestionsNote: Each one keeps researching when you leave its page. Open it to see where it has got to.
main.removeQuestionAsk: Remove this question from your list? Its steps and its letter go with it, and research still running stops. The rules it found stay, for every family.
main.questionRemoved: The question was removed from your list.
main.questionForClaim: For a claim in your case
main.question: The question, in any language
main.countriesNote: {count} countries were researched ahead and show the date they were verified. Any other country is researched now and says so.
main.offlineNote: This copy runs offline on scripted responses, so only the prepared countries are researched in full. A live run with Gemini researches any country.
main.footer1: AfterLedger is built on Google Cloud: Gemini on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with the Agent Development Kit, Cloud Run, Firestore, Firebase, Document AI, Cloud Translation and Agent Search grounding.
main.footer2: The sample families, banks, insurers and papers are fictional. Regulators' rules and quotes are real and linked to their pages.
